name: helioterm
description: Independent model-bound semantic terminal with deterministic commands and persisted proof.

interface.longDescription: HelioTerm runs one reusable model-bound Codex leaf for bounded test, build, git, search, benchmark, and process observations, compresses noisy output, and verifies the persisted role, model, parent, commands, and budgets.
defaultPrompt: Use $helioterm direct mode. On Windows, use system powershell.exe for its one local call.
